summary: Computes an audio filter parameter by walking a keyframe linked list (head at this+0x38) up to a target time of session time (dbl_8AFEA0) plus 5400.0 for session type 7 or 3000.0 otherwise, tracking min/max of node values at +8 until a node time at +0 exceeds the target. Returns ThresholdBasedReturn of the average (min+max)*0.5 offset by this+0x104, clamped to [0,1] (0.0 when the average is negative). When no curve is set (this+0x38 is null), falls back to status codes based on this+0x20 / this+0x24: 2 when this+0x20 is 0.0, 3 when this+0x24 is 0.0, 5 when this+0x24 is >= 0.6, else 4.

local_names.v1: keyframe node pointer traversed through the +12 next link
local_names.v8: target time = session time + horizon (5400.0 for session type 7, else 3000.0)
local_names.v7: clamped version of v4 fed to ThresholdBasedReturn

operations.description: Read the keyframe list head at this + 0x38; when non-null take the curve path, otherwise fall through to the status-code fallback.
Target time v8 = dbl_8AFEA0 + (dword_7C56A4 == 7 ? 5400.0 : 3000.0); the session-type global selects the horizon.
Initialize min (v3) and max (v6) from the head node value at +8.
Traverse the keyframe chain via the next pointer at +12: update v6 = max(v6, node value) and v3 = min(v3, node value), break when the node time at +0 exceeds the target time v8.
v4 = (v3 + v6) * 0.5 + *(this + 0x104): average of min/max offset by the this field.
Clamp v7 to the [0,1] range (force 0 when v4 is negative, 1.0 when it exceeds 1.0).
Return ThresholdBasedReturn(v7) on the positive path, or ThresholdBasedReturn(0.0) when the average is negative.
Null-curve fallback chain on this fields: return 2 when *(this + 0x20) == 0.0; return 3 when *(this + 0x24) == 0.0; else result = 4, upgraded to 5 when *(this + 0x24) >= 0.6.
Return the status code (2, 3, 4 or 5) selected by the fallback chain when no keyframe curve is configured.
